keywords.name: Attack
text: The attack ability on a card or weapon lets you declare an attack. The card moves onto the combat chain, the chain opens if closed, and you must declare a legal target (enemy hero or ally).

keywords.name: Go again
text: After this resolves, gain 1 action point. This lets you take another action in the same turn. Multiple instances don't stack — you can only have go again once.

keywords.name: Dominate
text: This attack can't be defended by more than one card from hand. Equipment can still defend alongside that one card.

keywords.name: Overpower
text: This attack can't be defended by more than one action card. Unlike Dominate, you can still block with multiple non-action cards.

keywords.name: Crush
text: A triggered ability that fires when this attack deals 4 or more damage. Common on Guardian cards.

keywords.name: Piercing N
text: If this is defended, the defending hero loses N life. Bypasses the defense value entirely.

keywords.name: Reprise
text: Triggers if the defending hero defended with a card from hand this chain link. Rewards you for drawing out your opponent's hand.

keywords.name: Battleworn
text: When the combat chain closes, if this equipment defended, put a -1 defense counter on it. Equipment wears down over time.

keywords.name: Blade Break
text: When the combat chain closes, if this defended, destroy it. One-time use, then it's gone.

keywords.name: Temper
text: When the combat chain closes, if this defended, put it on the bottom of your deck. It returns for later use rather than being destroyed.

keywords.name: Ward N
text: If you would be dealt N or less damage, destroy this and prevent that damage. Absorbs small hits entirely.

keywords.name: Spellvoid N
text: If you would be dealt N or less arcane damage, you may destroy this and prevent it. Similar to Ward but specifically for arcane damage and optional.

keywords.name: Spectra
text: This can be attacked (normally only heroes/allies can). When it becomes the target of an attack, destroy it. Illusionist auras use this.

keywords.name: Phantasm
text: When defended by a non-Illusionist attack action card with 6 or more power, destroy this. Powerful illusion that shatters against big physical attacks.

keywords.name: Mirage N
text: When defending a non-Illusionist attack, this gets +N defense. Illusionist aura shields.

keywords.name: Fusion
text: Optional additional cost when playing: reveal a card with the specified supertype(s) from your hand. Doing so unlocks a bonus effect. Combines elements together.

keywords.name: Heave N
text: While this is in your hand, you may pay N resource points plus put it face-up into your arsenal from hand. Lets you stash a card for later at a discount.

keywords.name: Scrap
text: Optional additional cost: banish an item or equipment you control. Reduces the resource cost. Mechanologist theme.

keywords.name: Beat Chest
text: Optional additional cost: discard a card with 6 or more power. Brute-themed cost reduction.

keywords.name: Material
text: While this card is under a permanent (attached/equipped), that permanent gains its listed effects.

keywords.name: Contract
text: You are contracted to complete a specific objective. If you do, you get the listed reward. Failing may have consequences.

keywords.name: Surge
text: If this deals N or more damage, get a bonus effect. Rewards big hits.

keywords.name: Combo
text: If the named card was the last attack in the combat chain, this gets a bonus. Builds on your previous attack.

keywords.name: Rune Gate
text: If you control enough Runechants (Runeblade tokens), you may play this from your banished zone. Runeblade recursion mechanic.

keywords.name: Quell N
text: If you would be dealt N or less damage, prevent that damage. Similar to Ward but doesn't destroy the source — can be used repeatedly.

keywords.name: Legendary
text: You may only have 1 copy of this card in your card-pool, even if the format allows more copies.

keywords.name: Ephemeral
text: You can't include this in your card-pool. It can only be created during the game by effects (usually tokens).

keywords.name: Modular
text: This may be equipped to any equipment zone (Arms, Chest, Head, or Legs). Flexible placement.

keywords.name: Cloaked
text: Equip this face-down. Your opponent doesn't know what it is until you use it. Assassin/Ninja theme.

keywords.name: Perched
text: Can be equipped in addition to a two-handed weapon. Occupies the same weapon zone as the 2H without taking an extra slot.

keywords.name: Arcane Shelter N
text: If you would be dealt N or less damage, prevent that damage. Ward variant that doesn't require destroying the source.

keywords.name: Guardwell
text: When the combat chain closes, if this defended, it stays equipped instead of being destroyed or removed.

keywords.name: Ambush
text: While this is in your arsenal, you may defend with it as though it were in your hand. Surprise blocks from the arsenal.

keywords.name: Crank
text: As this enters the arena, you may remove a steam counter from a Mechanologist item to get a bonus.

keywords.name: Blood Debt
text: While in your banished zone at the start of your turn, you lose 1 life. Shadow cards have a cost for sitting in banish.

keywords.name: Galvanize
text: When this defends, you may banish a card from your graveyard for a bonus. Mechanologist recursion.

keywords.name: Bond
text: If an Elemental card was pitched to pay for an Elemental card this turn, get a bonus. Rewards staying in-element.

keywords.name: Flow
text: If you played a card with the matching element this turn, get a bonus. Rewards elemental sequencing.

keywords.name: Unity
text: When this defends together with a card from hand, this gets +1 defense. Skilled at cooperative defense.

keywords.name: Heavy
text: If this is the only card equipped to your weapon zones (no off-hand), get a bonus. Guardian two-hander theme.

keywords.name: Tower
text: If this has 13 or more power, unlock a powerful effect. Guardian build-up mechanic.

keywords.name: High Tide
text: If there are 2 or more Wizard non-attack action cards in your graveyard, get a bonus. Wizard spellcasting.

keywords.name: Solflare
text: When this is charged to your hero's soul, trigger an effect. Light Warrior soul-charging.

keywords.name: Go Fish
text: When this hits a hero, they reveal their hand and you may banish a card from it. Mind games.

keywords.name: Quickstrike
text: If this has go again at the start of the chain link, get a bonus. Rewards building speed.

keywords.name: Starfall
text: If an instant has been put into your graveyard this turn, get a bonus. Rewards quick reflexes.

keywords.name: Essence
text: Allows your hero to include cards with certain talents even if they don't have that talent. Expands your card-pool options.

keywords.name: Meld
text: Pay double cost to play both halves of a split card at once. The melded card has properties of both sides.

keywords.name: Stealth
text: This card does nothing special on its own — Stealth has no inherent mechanical effect. Assassin cards use Stealth as a label for other abilities to reference.

keywords.name: Pairs with [OBJECT]
text: Equip this only if you already have the named object equipped. Paired items that work together.

keywords.name: Protect
text: You may defend any hero attacked by an opponent with this card. Act as a bodyguard for your team in multiplayer.
